checkpoint.role: trained JE10 total reward Critic; raw-reward A1 is an explicitly approximate same-Critic diagnostic, not a separately raw-trained Critic

independent_recalculation: all 8802 ticks, exact unquantized JSON equality; independently extracted identical Critic
regeneration: all six predeclared new seeds; no outcome selection

rows.scene_rules: 生产原生砖块/糖泡/道具；2400 tick上限；完整终局
rows.all_tick_recalculation: exact JSON equality after independent Critic extraction
rows.limitations: offline_approximate_one_step：生产Web逐合法联合动作真实一步反事实，同状态/RNG快照、冻结实际对手动作；同checkpoint Actor与训练总奖励Critic。raw为继承H8任务账本（含原有运输塑形，JE10控制死亡修正保留），shaped再含JE10控制与路线PBRS。两侧共用total-reward Critic，raw不是独立原始任务Critic；ΔA是两种奖励口径的同Critic差，不是跨代Critic差。完整同版本账本从本局初态冷启动并逐步保存，事件来自Web、CPU安全检测来自封存训练源码，属于离线Web指标近似，非历史训练rollout。场景映射native=8/open=0/carry_home=2，Web时限与训练课程HORIZON不同；Web立即终局不追加训练危险残留结算tick，未结算余额不冒充已付奖励。训练ledger的D标签使用己半场，页面按真实3×3笼校正为C，Phi和Reward原值不改。
